name: The Yuri Doctor
source:
As the owner of a private clinic Alison doesn't have a lot of time to socialise. She puts her heart and soul into her work, but that doesn't leave a lot of room for love.

Until a beautiful pregnant lady shows up as Alison's newest and most interesting patient that is. Elisa immediately takes Alison's breath away, even if they'll never be able to be together.

And yet Elisa keeps showing up for appointment after appointment, from chest pains due to lactation problems to vaginal examinations, growing closer to Alison each time.

Is there just a small spark of excitement between them or can it ever grow into something more?

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?product_code=1147&af=3a123f6214695bfacaa881bd3117c693]MangaGamer[/url]]
